definition: κόλπος, -ου, ὁ  [in LXX chiefly for חֵיק ;] __1. prop., the bosom: Jhn.13:23; fig., of close association, ἐν (εἰς τὸν) τοῖς κ. Ἀβραάμ, Luk.16:22-23 (cf. 4Ma.13:16); ὁ ὢν εἰς τὸν κ. τ. πατρός, Jhn.1:18  __2. The bosom or fold of a loose garment falling over a girdle, used as a  pocket, hence figuratively, εἰς τὸν κ. Isa.65:6, Jer.32:18 : Luk.6:38  __3. A bosom-like hollow, as a bay or gulf: Act.27:39.† (AS)
